BRIGHTWATER UTILITIES REPORTS Q1 FISCAL 2026 RESULTS

Brightwater Utilities (NASDAQ: BWTR) today announced financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026. Revenue was $712.4 million, up 3.4% year over year. GAAP net income was $93.1 million, or $0.60 per diluted share. Non-GAAP net income was $96.6 million, or $0.62 per diluted share. Non-GAAP measures exclude stock-based compensation of $4.5 million; there were no other adjusting items in the quarter. For fiscal 2026, the company expects revenue of $2,900.0 million to $2,960.0 million on a GAAP basis.

Condensed income statement (in millions, unaudited)
  Revenue                       $712.4 million
  Cost of revenue               $391.3 million
  Gross profit                  $321.1 million
  Operating expenses            $201.7 million
  Operating income (loss)       $119.4 million
  Income tax expense            $26.3 million
  Net income (loss)             $93.1 million
  Diluted shares (millions)     156.0

Prior-year quarter: revenue $688.9 million; operating income $92.0 million.
